svg.title: Sampark — every expression to a confirmed voice
svg.desc: Detailed flow from the React interface through microphone and camera inputs, local open-source processing, hosted speech and lip recognition, gpt-oss via Groq, validation and confirmation, and voice or avatar output. Cloud and local components have separate colours.

g.text: Solid arrows = normal flow. Dashed arrows = optional context, clarification, or fallback.

g.title: Your space: React + React DOM: TypeScript checks data. Tailwind styles it. Motion animates it. Lucide supplies icons. Sonner shows feedback. Vite serves the UI on 5173. REST requests reach FastAPI on 8765; WebSocket sends live draft updates back.
g.text: TypeScript checks data. Tailwind styles it. Motion animates it. Lucide supplies icons. Sonner shows feedback.
Vite serves the UI on 5173. REST requests reach FastAPI on 8765; WebSocket sends live draft updates back.

g.title: Choose inputs + allow permissions: Our ConsentRegistry gates microphone, camera, avatar, and optional personalization separately.
sounddevice → microphone: MacBook microphone • 16 kHz mono PCM Our pause detector cuts short audio segments.
g.text: Our pause detector cuts short audio segments.

g.title: OpenCV → CameraHub: Captures the webcam once and shares frames with gesture, face, and preview services. The frontend does not open a second webcam. Camera permission is required.
g.text: Captures the webcam once and shares frames with gesture, face, and preview services.
The frontend does not open a second webcam. Camera permission is required.

g.title: ElevenLabs Scribe v2: Audio goes to the hosted recognition API. Returns text, language, and confidence.
g.text: Audio goes to the hosted recognition API.

g.title: MediaPipe → hand gestures: Recognizes supported hand labels locally. Stability rules stop flickering detections.
MediaPipe → face + mouth: Finds landmarks, mouth activity, head angle. Not a sentence decoder by itself.
g.text: Finds landmarks, mouth activity, head angle.
Not a sentence decoder by itself.

g.title: GestureService → word mapping: Maps stable gestures to chosen words. Current defaults: yes, no, wait.
g.text: Maps stable gestures to chosen words.

g.title: Auto-AVSR via HF Space: gradio-client sends an eligible lip video clip. Returns a weak text hint, not certain meaning.
g.text: gradio-client sends an eligible lip video clip.
Returns a weak text hint, not certain meaning.

g.title: Partner question / optional: A PARTNER turn uses the same mic + Scribe. Save its transcript as recent context.
g.text: A PARTNER turn uses the same mic + Scribe.
Save its transcript as recent context.

g.title: FragmentCollector → “What I caught”: Patient speech + gesture words + lip hints are collected in order, with pauses and evidence flags. Deterministic cleanup marks fillers, repeats, and stutters. WebSocket updates the visible draft.
g.text: Patient speech + gesture words + lip hints are collected in order, with pauses and evidence flags.
Deterministic cleanup marks fillers, repeats, and stutters. WebSocket updates the visible draft.

g.title: Your vocabulary / optional: Phrasebook + profile terms: local JSON. Used only with personalization permission.
EvidencePacket → text and derived signals: Combines cleaned fragments, labelled recent dialogue, optional vocabulary, and prior clarifications. Raw microphone audio and video are not sent to Groq.
g.text: Combines cleaned fragments, labelled recent dialogue, optional vocabulary, and prior clarifications.
Raw microphone audio and video are not sent to Groq.

g.title: gpt-oss-20b → served by Groq: Open-weight language model. Hosted inference here, not a local model process. Returns 2–3 candidate sentences or asks for clarification. Groq SDK carries the request.
g.text: Open-weight language model. Hosted inference here, not a local model process.
Returns 2–3 candidate sentences or asks for clarification. Groq SDK carries the request.

g.title: Pydantic + our evidence validator: Check JSON shape, fragment coverage, and allowed additions. Reject unsupported meaning; show added words to the user.
g.text: Check JSON shape, fragment coverage, and allowed additions.
Reject unsupported meaning; show added words to the user.

g.title: Need more meaning? Ask.: Show a clarification question or allow editing. Answer → update evidence → try again.
g.text: Show a clarification question or allow editing.

g.title: Review → select, edit, or cancel: Candidate wording and added words appear in the app. Edited text is shown back before speaking. If auto-say is enabled, an eligible candidate has a 3-second cancel/edit window. Lip-only is excluded.
g.text: Candidate wording and added words appear in the app. Edited text is shown back before speaking.
If auto-say is enabled, an eligible candidate has a 3-second cancel/edit window. Lip-only is excluded.

g.title: ConfirmationRegistry → one-time approval ID: Bind the exact selected text to an expiring, single-use confirmation ID. Only a valid confirmation ID can unlock the speech-output service.
g.text: Bind the exact selected text to an expiring, single-use confirmation ID.
Only a valid confirmation ID can unlock the speech-output service.

g.title: The local backbone: FastAPI + Uvicorn: routes and server Pydantic: data validation EventBus + WebSocket: live updates HealthRegistry: service availability Metrics: timings and counts python-dotenv: private configuration HTTPX / SDKs: external connections Our TurnMachine: coordinates each turn
ElevenLabs Flash v2.5: Confirmed text → synthetic voice audio. API model: eleven_flash_v2_5.
Tavus → avatar echo: daily-python sends the approved echo. Try audio echo, then text echo if needed.
g.text: Try audio echo, then text echo if needed.

g.title: Browser audio + subtitles: Play approved audio locally if avatar fails or no avatar session is available.
g.text: Play approved audio locally if avatar fails
or no avatar session is available.

g.title: Daily.js → avatar player: Browser receives room video + audio. Its microphone and camera stay off.
g.text: Its microphone and camera stay off.
Audio → ElevenLabs Scribe. Text evidence → Groq. Lip clip → HF Space when used.
Confirmed text/audio → ElevenLabs / Tavus / Daily for output. The entire system is not offline.
Optional local lip path: Auto-AVSR + PyTorch instead of the hosted Space. Code and model licences are separate.
Based on repository code + non-secret configuration • 1 November 2026 • no credentials or patient data included
